title: Flow: project-foundation
description: North Star: a fully wired, CI-enforced dev toolchain for the litestar-batteries library so the TDD workflow and quality gates in workflow.md are runnable. Scope: ruff (lint+format), mypy+pyright (strict, py.typed), pytest+pytest-cov (80% gate), a real smoke test, and GitHub Actions CI across Python 3.10 & 3.14. Litestar runtime dep is deferred to the first battery.
notes:
Decisions (from PRD grilling 2026-07-23): (1) Type checking = BOTH mypy + pyright, strict, matching Litestar's own CI. (2) Litestar runtime dep DEFERRED to first battery; foundation keeps dependencies=[]. (3) CI matrix = Python 3.10 (floor) + 3.14 (newest) only. (4) Coverage = hard 80% gate from day one, so the smoke test must import litestar_batteries and assert __version__ to cover the package. Package manager = uv; build backend = uv_build; src/ layout; py.typed present.
Structure: 2 chapters. Ch1 local-tooling (axm) = pyproject dev-deps + tool config + tests/smoke test, all local commands green. Ch2 ci-pipeline (1yk) = GitHub Actions running the same gates on the matrix; blocked by Ch1. Canonical verify: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src && uv run pyright && uv run pytest.
WORKFLOW GAP: Flow's shipped .git/hooks/pre-commit uses PEP 604/585 annotations (str | None, list[dict]) evaluated at def time, so it crashes under system Python 3.9.6 and blocks ALL commits. Fixed the local hook by adding 'from __future__ import annotations'. Also note: the hook early-exits without a .beads/ dir, and bd here uses dolt embedded (no .beads/), so auto-sync via hook never runs — manual /flow:sync is the path. Upstream template (~/.claude/plugins/.../flow/hooks/pre-commit) still has the bug.

Flow archived 2026-07-23 -> .agents/archive/project-foundation/. Merged in PR #1 (6edb155).

title: idempotency: implement ASGI middleware (buffer body, store lookup, replay, 409, 422, 5xx)
description: middleware.py: ASGIMiddleware subclass (scopes=(ScopeType.HTTP,)). handle(): skip if method not in config.methods or Idempotency-Key absent -> next_app. Else: store=scope['app'].stores.get(config.store); store_key namespaced f'{method}:{path}:{key}'. Buffer request body from receive (assemble http.request chunks) and build a replay receive for next_app; compute sha256 request_hash. Lookup existing record (msgspec.msgpack): state 'done' -> if request_hash mismatch 422 else replay (status, media_type, body) + Idempotency-Replayed header; state 'processing' -> 409. If none: set 'processing' sentinel (expires_in=lock_ttl); run next_app with a send-wrapper capturing http.response.start (status, content-type via MutableScopeHeaders) and http.response.body chunks (respect more_body); on completion status<500 -> store 'done' record (expires_in=ttl); status>=500 or exception -> delete sentinel so retry re-runs. NOTE limitation in code+spec: get->set is not atomic across the Store ABC, so the in-flight 409 is best-effort, not a distributed lock.
acceptance_criteria: All T2 tests pass (Green); mypy+pyright strict clean; body buffering replays correctly to the handler.
notes: [cf3e7db] Green. Content-type captured by scanning raw response headers (avoids MutableScopeHeaders.get untyped). asyncio.Lock serializes get->set-sentinel per worker; 409 tested via seeded in-flight record (transport concurrency was nondeterministic). Full gate green, 98% cov.
close_reason: [cf3e7db] middleware implemented TDD; replay/409/422/5xx + body buffering; full gate green, 98% cov

title: idempotency-key battery: dedupe retried unsafe requests via Idempotency-Key

title: health timeout: avoid orphaning the check task on caller cancellation
description: Exhaustive review of PR #8 found that the task + asyncio.wait deadline-detection variant does NOT cancel the check task when the awaiting readiness coroutine is cancelled (client disconnect / shutdown) -> orphaned check coroutine (regression from asyncio.wait_for). Also contextlib.suppress(CancelledError) around 'await task' could swallow a concurrent cancellation of the handler. Fix: revert to asyncio.wait_for (correct cancellation) and disambiguate the check's own asyncio.TimeoutError via a _guarded wrapper that re-types it as private _CheckFailed; bare asyncio.TimeoutError out of wait_for then means only the deadline. Simpler; removes contextlib. Covered by existing 12 tests.
acceptance_criteria: No orphaned check task on caller cancellation; own-TimeoutError still preserved (bounded+unbounded); full gate green, 100% cov.
notes: [b2a0ecf] wait_for + _guarded/_CheckFailed re-typing; caller cancellation cancels the check; contextlib removed; gate 12 passed 100% cov.
close_reason: [b2a0ecf] cancellation-safe wait_for + _guarded disambiguation; gate green 100% cov

title: health timeout: distinguish wrapper deadline from check-raised TimeoutError
description: PR #8 review (Codex + CodeRabbit): readiness() wraps both the bounded wait_for path and the unbounded await in one 'except asyncio.TimeoutError'. A check that raises its own asyncio.TimeoutError is misclassified as the wrapper deadline -> 'timed out after {hc.timeout}s' (and 'timed out after Nones' on the timeout=None path), discarding the real error. asyncio.wait_for conflates the two by exception type, so distinguish by MECHANISM: run the check as a task, treat 'still pending after asyncio.wait(timeout=...)' as our deadline, and propagate any check-raised exception (incl. TimeoutError) unchanged. Also: strengthen test_readiness_timeout_none_is_unbounded to use a slow check; escape 'float | None' pipe in archived spec.md table (MD056).
acceptance_criteria: A check raising its own TimeoutError surfaces its real message (not the wrapper deadline) under both timeout=None and a finite timeout; wrapper deadline still reports 'timed out after {t}s'; full gate green.
notes: Fixed in this branch: task-based asyncio.wait deadline detection + _DeadlineExceeded sentinel; task.result() re-raises check's own exception. 2 regression tests (bounded/unbounded own-TimeoutError), strengthened none-unbounded test to _slow, escaped MD056 pipe in archived spec. Gate: 12 passed, 100% cov.
close_reason: [b153fd6] mechanism-based deadline detection; own-TimeoutError preserved; gate green 12 passed 100% cov
